content: We need to determine number of CH3 groups in the sample's compound. We have no description of the sample. We need to get NMR spectra to infer methyl groups. Use proton NMR to see signals around 0.9 ppm (triplet etc). Could also use carbon NMR for methyl carbon ~10-30 ppm. We need to measure spectra. Use proton_nmr_spectra tool. Then analyze peaks for methyl. Let's call tool.
